text: As a kid, I couldn't leave anything alone.
Remotes. Radios. The old phone in the drawer. I opened all of them.
Most of them never worked again. I didn't care.
Then you grow up. Someone tells you to pick a lane, and the screwdriver goes back in the drawer.
But that itch never really leaves.
Now there's a new tool in my hand.
And it lets me open things up again. Ideas. Little tools I build in an evening, break, and build again.
I'm not an engineer. I'm still just that kid.
The only thing missing was people who still open things up too.
